raw:
{
  "items": [
    {
      "category": "domain_extent",
      "entity": "Rectangular design domain",
      "issue": "figure_only",
      "description": "Sec. 4.1 refers dimensions to unavailable Fig. 8(a). No numerical dimensions or aspect ratio are given, and 'width greater than length' does not explicitly identify the coordinate axes. Let B denote the horizontal span between clamps and H the vertical height.",
      "readings": [
        "B = 2, H = 1 in a common length unit",
        "B = 3, H = 1 in a common length unit",
        "B = 1, H = 2 if 'width' denotes the vertical dimension"
      ],
      "effect": "layout"
    },
    {
      "category": "domain_extent",
      "entity": "Uniform out-of-plane thickness",
      "issue": "missing",
      "description": "The example is described as 2D, but no thickness or per-unit-thickness convention is stated. For a fixed resultant in-plane force, uniform thickness scales compliance.",
      "readings": [
        "Unit thickness, t = 1",
        "Uniform thickness t = 0.1 in the chosen length unit"
      ],
      "effect": "scale_only"
    },
    {
      "category": "load_direction",
      "entity": "Force at the top center",
      "issue": "conflicting",
      "description": "Sec. 4.1 calls the force 'horizontally downward', combining incompatible direction descriptions. Fig. 8(a) is unavailable.",
      "readings": [
        "Vertically downward: F = (0, -P)",
        "Horizontally rightward: F = (P, 0)",
        "Horizontally leftward: F = (-P, 0)",
        "Obliquely downward, for example F = (P/sqrt(2), -P/sqrt(2))"
      ],
      "effect": "layout"
    },
    {
      "category": "load_extent_distribution",
      "entity": "Application of the top-center force",
      "issue": "missing",
      "description": "Sec. 4.1 determines the load center but does not specify whether the force is concentrated or distributed, its footprint, or its nodal discretization.",
      "readings": [
        "A concentrated force P at the top-center node",
        "Equal forces P/2 at the two top nodes immediately bracketing the center",
        "Uniform traction with resultant P over x/B in [0.45, 0.55] on y = H"
      ],
      "effect": "layout"
    },
    {
      "category": "load_magnitude",
      "entity": "Low-fidelity applied force",
      "issue": "missing",
      "description": "Secs. 3.2 and 4.1–4.1.1 provide no numerical low-fidelity force magnitude or force normalization. The reference to Fig. 8(a) cannot supply a value from the available text.",
      "readings": [
        "Resultant force magnitude P = 1 in units consistent with E = 1",
        "Resultant force magnitude P = 10 in the same units"
      ],
      "effect": "scale_only"
    },
    {
      "category": "passive_region",
      "entity": "Non-design material near the clamps and load",
      "issue": "missing",
      "description": "Secs. 4.1–4.1.1 do not state whether support strips or load-introduction pads are forced solid, or give their extents.",
      "readings": [
        "No passive regions; all cells in the rectangle are designable",
        "One-cell-thick solid end strips and a centered two-cell-wide, one-cell-deep solid load pad",
        "Solid end strips of width 0.05B and a centered load pad of width 0.1B and depth 0.05H"
      ],
      "effect": "layout"
    },
    {
      "category": "volume_fraction",
      "entity": "The 160 low-fidelity volume limits",
      "issue": "missing",
      "description": "Sec. 4.1.1 specifies 160 volume limits spanning 0.25–0.50, but does not give their spacing or complete values.",
      "readings": [
        "Uniform inclusive sampling: V0(k) = 0.25 + 0.25k/159, k = 0,...,159",
        "Nonuniform inclusive sampling: V0(k) = 0.25 + 0.25(k/159)^2, k = 0,...,159"
      ],
      "effect": "layout"
    },
    {
      "category": "volume_fraction",
      "entity": "Volume limits of the 15 representative Fig. 8(b) designs",
      "issue": "figure_only",
      "description": "Sec. 4.1.1 states that five designs are shown for each stated L_min, in increasing volume-fraction order. It does not identify their five volume limits or their indices within the 160-sample sweep.",
      "readings": [
        "For each L_min, select sorted sample indices {0, 40, 80, 120, 159}",
        "For each L_min, select sorted sample indices {0, 20, 60, 100, 159}"
      ],
      "effect": "layout"
    },
    {
      "category": "volume_fraction",
      "entity": "Element volume interpolation",
      "issue": "missing",
      "description": "Eq. (33) names V(mu1, mu2, rho) without defining it. In particular, the optimization volume rule for the additional macroscopic variable rho is not stated explicitly.",
      "readings": [
        "Use the union area of bars with the scaled widths in Eq. (32): v_e = rho(mu1 + mu2) - rho^2 mu1 mu2",
        "Treat rho as a macroscopic occupancy multiplier: v_e = rho(mu1 + mu2 - mu1 mu2)"
      ],
      "effect": "layout"
    },
    {
      "category": "volume_fraction",
      "entity": "Volume normalization and passive-material accounting",
      "issue": "missing",
      "description": "Eqs. (22) and (33) do not define the normalization of V or the budget treatment of any non-design material. These conventions differ if solid pads or strips are used.",
      "readings": [
        "Total solid volume, including passive material, divided by the gross rectangular volume is bounded by V0",
        "Only designable-region material is counted, divided by the designable-region volume; passive solids are outside the V0 budget"
      ],
      "effect": "layout"
    },
    {
      "category": "other",
      "entity": "Low-fidelity stiffness objective",
      "issue": "vague",
      "description": "Secs. 3.2 and 4.1.1 call the objective stiffness optimization but leave obj unspecified in Eqs. (22) and (33). Sec. 4.1.2 explicitly minimizes maximum displacement at the later high-fidelity stage; it does not establish the low-fidelity objective.",
      "readings": [
        "Minimize compliance F^T U",
        "Minimize the maximum nodal displacement magnitude"
      ],
      "effect": "layout"
    },
    {
      "category": "material",
      "entity": "Two-dimensional elastic constitutive assumption",
      "issue": "missing",
      "description": "Sec. 3.2 fixes the base material at E = 1 and nu = 0.3, but neither it nor Sec. 4.1.1 specifies plane stress or plane strain for the low-fidelity model and its homogenized properties.",
      "readings": [
        "Plane stress",
        "Plane strain"
      ],
      "effect": "layout"
    },
    {
      "category": "material",
      "entity": "Homogenized elasticity data required by Eq. (31)",
      "issue": "missing",
      "description": "Sec. 2.1 supplies the polynomial form but not its coefficients, polynomial orders, parameter-grid resolution, or numerical homogenization dataset. Eq. (31) requires these geometry-dependent orthotropic tensors. A conventional isotropic scalar-density law would be a model substitution, rather than an exact implementation of Fig. 8.",
      "readings": [
        "Reconstruct a uniform 21-by-21 parameter dataset and fit q_max = r_max = 3",
        "Reconstruct a uniform 101-by-101 parameter dataset and fit q_max = r_max = 5"
      ],
      "effect": "layout"
    },
    {
      "category": "filter_or_solver_setting",
      "entity": "Upper bar-width bound L_max",
      "issue": "missing",
      "description": "Eq. (33) introduces L_max but Sec. 4.1.1 does not assign it a value. The [0,1]^2 surrogate sampling domain in Sec. 2.1 establishes the available parameter range, not an explicit numerical choice for this optimization bound.",
      "readings": [
        "L_max = 1",
        "L_max = 0.8"
      ],
      "effect": "layout"
    },
    {
      "category": "filter_or_solver_setting",
      "entity": "Void stiffness and singular-system handling",
      "issue": "missing",
      "description": "Sec. 4.1.1 permits rho = 0, but does not describe residual void stiffness, regularization of the fitted tensors near zero widths, or treatment of disconnected degrees of freedom.",
      "readings": [
        "Exact zero stiffness in voids, with inactive degrees of freedom removed",
        "Add an isotropic residual stiffness E_void/E_solid = 1e-9",
        "Add an isotropic residual stiffness E_void/E_solid = 1e-3"
      ],
      "effect": "layout"
    },
    {
      "category": "filter_or_solver_setting",
      "entity": "Spatial filtering and regularization of low-fidelity fields",
      "issue": "missing",
      "description": "Secs. 3.2 and 4.1.1 give no spatial filter type, radius, filtered fields, or boundary treatment. The stated L_min values bound bar parameters in Eq. (33); they do not specify a macroscopic density-filter radius.",
      "readings": [
        "No spatial filtering",
        "Linear density filter of radius 1.5 element widths on mu1, mu2, and rho, with renormalized boundary weights; theta unfiltered",
        "Helmholtz filter of radius 0.05H on mu1, mu2, and rho with zero-normal-gradient boundary conditions; theta unfiltered"
      ],
      "effect": "layout"
    },
    {
      "category": "filter_or_solver_setting",
      "entity": "Low-fidelity optimization algorithm and update limits",
      "issue": "missing",
      "description": "Eqs. (22) and (33) define constraints but do not identify the numerical optimizer, update rules, or move limits used to obtain the nonconvex low-fidelity solutions.",
      "readings": [
        "MMA with a move limit of 0.1 of each variable's allowed range",
        "Sequential quadratic programming with line search and the stated box constraints"
      ],
      "effect": "layout"
    },
    {
      "category": "filter_or_solver_setting",
      "entity": "Initialization and continuation across the volume sweep",
      "issue": "missing",
      "description": "Sec. 4.1.1 does not give initial width, orientation, and macroscopic-density fields, or say whether each volume-limit run starts independently or from a previous solution.",
      "readings": [
        "Independent uniform equal-width starts, theta = 0, with density adjusted to the prescribed volume limit",
        "Independent uniform equal-width starts, theta = pi/4, with density adjusted to the prescribed volume limit",
        "Warm-start each increasing-volume run from the preceding converged design"
      ],
      "effect": "layout"
    },
    {
      "category": "filter_or_solver_setting",
      "entity": "Low-fidelity termination criteria",
      "issue": "missing",
      "description": "Sec. 4.1.1 gives no convergence tolerance or iteration cap. The 300 iterations in Sec. 4.1.2 concern the later evolutionary optimization.",
      "readings": [
        "Stop at maximum normalized design-variable change below 1e-3, with a 200-iteration cap",
        "Stop at relative objective change below 1e-5 over ten iterations, with a 1000-iteration cap"
      ],
      "effect": "layout"
    },
    {
      "category": "filter_or_solver_setting",
      "entity": "Enforcement of design symmetry",
      "issue": "missing",
      "description": "Secs. 4.1–4.1.1 do not say whether mirrored design variables are tied. Symmetric geometry and a vertical top-center load do not themselves specify a symmetry restriction on the optimization.",
      "readings": [
        "Optimize the full rectangle without tying mirrored design variables",
        "Enforce reflection symmetry about x = B/2, tying density and width fields and reflecting microstructure orientations"
      ],
      "effect": "layout"
    },
    {
      "category": "mesh",
      "entity": "Low-fidelity structured macro grid",
      "issue": "missing",
      "description": "The macro elements in Sec. 2.1 and coarse mesh in Sec. 2.2.1 have no numerical resolution specified for Sec. 4.1.1. The high-fidelity triangular meshing discussion does not determine this grid.",
      "readings": [
        "For B/H = 2, use 120-by-60 square macro elements",
        "For B/H = 2, use 240-by-120 square macro elements"
      ],
      "effect": "layout"
    },
    {
      "category": "mesh",
      "entity": "Low-fidelity finite-element interpolation and integration",
      "issue": "missing",
      "description": "The text does not identify the low-fidelity element order or quadrature rule. A structured grid alone does not determine these choices.",
      "readings": [
        "Four-node bilinear quadrilateral elements with 2-by-2 Gauss integration",
        "Nine-node quadratic quadrilateral elements with 3-by-3 Gauss integration"
      ],
      "effect": "layout"
    }
  ]
}
